toasts: Server did not confirm the Base URL clear; the stored URL may still be set.

explanation: When the new UI submitted an explicit clear against old backend 19b0557 (which ignores clear_base_url and returns 200 with the non-null URL), the response confirmation guard in the new UI detected that response.base_url !== null. As expected, it kept the edit form open, displayed an error toast, and did NOT show a 'Settings updated' success toast. The independent API GET confirmed the stored loopback URL was retained.
